# Etem Utku Oylum

## Selected results

- AI visibility raised from below 2% to approximately 20%, placing the brand ahead of 80% of tracked competitors (SEO and GEO roadmap, ucm, 2026)
- Organic lead volume tripled across B2B and B2C (ucm, 2026)
- New Webflow website with its measurement layer: analytics, event tracking, lead attribution, web-to-app journeys, CRM integrations and advertising conversion events (ucm, 2026)
- AI-assisted lead qualification, validation and routing with n8n and Retool, connected through REST APIs, OAuth and webhooks (Zenjob)
- Consent-aware tracking with Segment and mParticle, and RAG-based internal knowledge tools (Zenjob)
- Meta Pixel, Conversions API, attribution and event diagnostics for advertisers (Concentrix)

## Things I build

- An attribution system in Google Tag Manager: UTM parameters and click IDs are classified into channel, channel detail and channel group and carried through the lead form, so every lead is attributed before it reaches the CRM; dashboards and budget decisions run on the same fields (ucm)
- AI visibility roadmaps: a measured prompt baseline across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity (mention and citation share), then crawl access through Google and the Bing index, a connected schema.org entity graph, answer-first pages built on the tracked prompts and the third-party sources models cite; re-measured and re-prioritised monthly
- n8n workflows that validate, qualify (with an AI agent) and route leads to Sales, Operations or Marketing, built with n8n and Retool (Zenjob)
- Lifecycle automation fed by warehouse data: Retool and Snowflake for the data, dbt models for attributes and events, Braze for automated journeys (Zenjob)
- A Webflow website with its full measurement layer (ucm)
- Consent-aware tracking with Segment and mParticle, and RAG-based internal knowledge tools (Zenjob)
